result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Company may terminate the Agreement or any SOW on 30 days’ written notice and receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period. Contractor cannot terminate while an SOW remains uncompleted, so it has no convenience right during a committed engagement; its 90-day right applies only when no SOW is outstanding. The changes are targeted and preserve the agreement’s continuing-term structure. Drafting is professional, though Contractor’s notice should ideally also be expressly described as written, and the refund could expressly use the term “pro rata” for precision.
